approvers: Nobody else; I decide, but the site manager and glazing subcontractor would need to accept it on site
reason: I spend about 2,400 euro a year on handover damage and it comes out of the job contingency. At 14 to 19 euro per m2 a block of glazing would cost me more than a year of damage, so it does not pay.
objection: I have never seen it used in Malta and there is no local job to visit. For that money I would rather just pay for snagging and cleaning.
instead: Keep doing nothing, clean and replace at snagging from the contingency. Maybe cheap tape or film on a few exposed windows if a block is high risk.
would_change_my_mind: A finished local block I can walk through, and a price down near 3 to 4 euro per m2 all-in.
